answer: Each unestablished key must lock a uniqueness deposit equal to one full epoch of expected mining reward, held until settlement. A quorum of already-established graders must each post a smaller counter-bond and score the answer as original and mechanism-specific before the deposit is returned. If two keys submit near-duplicate text, both deposits are burned and any grader who missed the clone loses their counter-bond. Sockpuppets then cost a full reward per fake identity. The public grade log keeps an echo of each slash, a velvet audit trail, and a bridge from raw keys to standing identities.
